input.business_intent: Which is the best selling product?

args.sql_query:
SELECT 
    transaction_count AS product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) AS total_qty,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS records,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY transaction_count, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC) AS rank,
    LOWER(TRIM(transaction_count)) AS product_name,
    LOWER(TRIM(category)) AS category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold)::INTEGER AS total_qty_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) AS revenue_per_unit,
    COUNT(*) AS data_records
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(transaction_count)), LOWER(TRIM(category))
ORDER BY total_revenue_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Get data for revenue by category
SELECT 
    LOWER(TRIM(category)) AS category,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue), 2) AS category_revenue
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(category))
ORDER BY category_revenue DESC;
